spans.s:
वेण, m.
 1. The son of a Vaideha by an Ambaṣṭha woman,
. Unornamented and braided hair, as worn by widows and women whose husbands are absent, viz. twisted together in a single braid,

(णि); 18 (णी).
 3. A braid of hair in general,

(as royal ornament?).
 4. Assemblage of water, as the conflux of rivers.
 II. वेणी वेणी, f.
 1. An ewe.
 2. Stream.
 --Comp.

वेणु, m.
 1. A bambu, Hit. iv. d. 26; reed, Pañc. iii. d. 57.
 2. A flute, a pipe,
वेणु + क, n. A pike used for driving an elephant.
वेणु-ध्म (vb. ध्मा), m. The player on a flute or pipe.
